moves.name: Static
moves.prompt: The camera is locked off on a tripod and does not move.

moves.name: Pan left
moves.prompt: The camera stays in place and {speed} pans left.

moves.name: Pan right
moves.prompt: The camera stays in place and {speed} pans right.

moves.name: Tilt up
moves.prompt: The camera stays in place and {speed} tilts up, revealing the subject from the ground to the eyes.

moves.name: Tilt down
moves.prompt: The camera stays in place and {speed} tilts down, from the subject's face to the ground.

moves.name: Dolly in
moves.prompt: The camera {speed} dollies forward toward the subject on a smooth track; the subject and the background stay in place.

moves.name: Dolly out
moves.prompt: The camera {speed} dollies straight back away from the subject, revealing more of the surroundings.

moves.name: Crash in
moves.prompt: The camera rushes forward toward the subject's face in a sudden fast dolly, creating urgency.

moves.name: Dolly zoom
moves.prompt: Dolly zoom (vertigo effect): the camera moves one way while the lens zooms the other, so the subject keeps the same size while the background stretches and warps.

moves.name: Truck left
moves.prompt: The camera {speed} slides left on a track, parallel to the scene, without turning.

moves.name: Truck right
moves.prompt: The camera {speed} slides right on a track, parallel to the scene, without turning.

moves.name: Orbit 180
moves.prompt: The camera {speed} circles halfway around the subject, keeping them centred.

moves.name: Orbit 360
moves.prompt: The camera {speed} circles all the way around the subject in a full 360-degree spin, keeping them centred.

moves.name: Arc left
moves.prompt: The camera {speed} moves in a gentle wide curve to the left around the subject, revealing their side profile.

moves.name: Arc right
moves.prompt: The camera {speed} moves in a gentle wide curve to the right around the subject, revealing their side profile.

moves.name: Pedestal up
moves.prompt: The whole camera {speed} rises straight up from waist level to eye level, without tilting.

moves.name: Pedestal down
moves.prompt: The whole camera {speed} lowers straight down from eye level to waist level, without tilting.

moves.name: Crane up
moves.prompt: The camera {speed} cranes up and back into a high angle, revealing the scene below.

moves.name: Crane down
moves.prompt: The camera {speed} cranes down from a high angle and lands at eye level with the subject.

moves.name: Zoom in
moves.prompt: The camera stays still while the lens {speed} zooms in on the subject.

moves.name: Zoom out
moves.prompt: The camera stays still while the lens {speed} zooms out from the subject.

moves.name: Snap zoom
moves.prompt: A sudden, extremely fast optical zoom straight into the subject's eyes.

moves.name: Snap zoom out
moves.prompt: A sudden, extremely fast optical zoom out from the subject to a wide view.

moves.name: Reveal from blur
moves.prompt: The shot starts completely out of focus; the lens {speed} pulls focus until the subject is razor sharp while the background stays soft.

moves.name: Rack focus
moves.prompt: The subject starts sharp with the background blurred; halfway through, the focus {speed} shifts so the subject blurs and the background turns sharp.

moves.name: Reveal from behind
moves.prompt: The camera starts blocked by a dark foreground wall or pillar and {speed} slides sideways past it to reveal the subject.

moves.name: Fly-through
moves.prompt: The camera {speed} flies forward through an opening in the foreground, a window or doorway, and on toward the subject.

moves.name: Macro zoom
moves.prompt: One continuous zoom pushes from the subject's face into extreme macro detail of the skin and eye, without a cut.

moves.name: Cosmic zoom
moves.prompt: One continuous hyper-zoom from outer space down through the clouds to the street and the subject, without a cut.

moves.name: Drone flyover
moves.prompt: A drone {speed} flies high over the subject and on across the landscape beyond.

moves.name: Drone reveal
moves.prompt: A drone {speed} rises and pulls back from the subject to reveal the vast landscape around them.

moves.name: Drone orbit
moves.prompt: A drone {speed} circles high around the subject in a wide sweeping arc, showing the scale of the place.

moves.name: Top-down
moves.prompt: The camera looks straight down from directly overhead, a god's-eye view, and {speed} descends toward the subject.

moves.name: FPV dive
moves.prompt: An FPV drone dives steeply and fast toward the ground, banking as it drops toward the subject.

moves.name: Handheld
moves.prompt: A handheld camera, documentary style: the frame breathes and sways slightly as an operator follows the action.

moves.name: Whip pan
moves.prompt: The camera whips sideways in a violent, very fast pan with strong directional motion blur.

moves.name: Dutch roll
moves.prompt: The camera {speed} rolls onto its side into a tilted dutch angle.

moves.name: Leading shot
moves.prompt: The subject walks toward the camera while the camera moves backward at the same speed, keeping them the same size in frame.

moves.name: Following shot
moves.prompt: The camera follows behind the subject at their pace as they move away from it.

moves.name: Side track left
moves.prompt: The camera moves left alongside the subject at their pace, keeping their profile in frame.

moves.name: Side track right
moves.prompt: The camera moves right alongside the subject at their pace, keeping their profile in frame.

moves.name: POV walk
moves.prompt: First-person view: the camera walks forward at eye height with the slight bob and sway of a person's steps, approaching the subject.
